items.author: yxlin_astro
items.title: Redshifts shifted after upgrade to lumenfit 2.5.0?
items.body: Hi all, after I upgrade lumenfit from 2.4.3 to 2.5.0 (pip, Nov 3), all my emission line redshifts come out lower by about 0.00028, same direction for every object. Same input spectra, same config file. Fitting H-alpha and [NII] on optical slit spectra, wavelength calibrated in air from arc lamps. Downgrade to 2.4.3 gives the old values again. Is this known? Thanks

items.author: kpd_wrangler
items.body: Works fine for me on 2.5.0, my fits are identical to 2.4. Did you actually read the changelog before upgrading? This is almost certainly a problem with your own calibration or config, not the library. Please do basic checks before posting on the help board. Marking as solved.

items.author: lumenfit_maint
items.title: lumenfit 2.5.0 released
items.body: lumenfit 2.5.0 is out on PyPI. Highlights: faster multi-component Gaussian fitting (about 2x on large cubes), new Voigt profile option, Python 3.13 support, fixed crash when masks contain NaN, docs reorganized. Full changelog in CHANGES.md. Thanks to all contributors!

items.author: lumenfit_maint
items.title: CHANGES.md (2.5.0 section)
items.body:
2.5.0 (2026-11-01)
- Multi-component Gaussian fitter rewritten, ~2x faster
- Add Voigt profile (profile='voigt')
- Support Python 3.13, drop 3.9
- Fix crash when mask contains NaN (#798)
- Refactor LineList and spectral frame handling (#812)
- Docs: new tutorial structure

items.author: yxlin_astro
items.title: my notes - PR 812 diff
items.body: github PR #812 'refactor spectral frame handling', merged Oct 22. In LineList.__init__ default wave_frame='air' -> wave_frame='vacuum'. Rest wavelengths now vacuum by default but my data is air. Vacuum/air wavelength ratio ~1.00028 at 6563A, that is exactly my offset (~83 km/s). No deprecation warning, CHANGES only says 'refactor'. Fix for me: LineList(..., wave_frame='air').
